name: Featherless AI
short: Serverless open-weights inference cloud hosting thousands of Hugging Face models with initial free trial tokens.

plans.name: Starter Trial
plans.notes: 100,000 free trial tokens on account creation. Generates an OpenAI-compatible API key for testing any of thousands of hosted open-source models directly in your local code.

plans.name: Developer Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Prepaid token pools (or monthly flat subscriptions) with no server cold-starts or idle charges across open checkpoints.
